diagnosis.cause: The base auditor searched the entire clean source/build workspace for PNG, JPG, EXR, MOV and MP4 files, so immutable Blender source test fixtures and installed application resources were misclassified as scene render leakage.
diagnosis.correctScope: Only the formal scene runtime root is a forbidden render-artifact location; expected source fixtures and application resources remain covered by the source/work manifests and resource ceiling.

allowed: one read-only C1 audit of the retained formal root
enumeration of expected source media and forbidden runtime media
recalculation of work, evidence and reserve resource checks
forbidden: modifying or deleting any retained base formal artifact, manifest, receipt or audit
source clone, checkout, build, Blender start, physics execution, save, render or ffmpeg process
threshold, fixture, candidate, physical result or visual verdict mutation
network call, engine remote write, force push, tag, release, signing, notarization or distribution
